Spoty 1.4.0 adds artist pages, search for albums and artists, and song sorting in every playlist, and fixes Next and Previous. It also uses much less memory when the window is large.

**Download Spoty:** [Windows (x64)](https://github.com/ladroxd/spoty/releases/download/v1.4.0/spoty.exe) · [SHA-256 checksum](https://github.com/ladroxd/spoty/releases/download/v1.4.0/spoty.exe.sha256)

No installer: download `spoty.exe` and run it. If Spoty is already running, quit it from the tray first. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the app isn't code-signed; click **More info → Run anyway**.

## New

- **Artist pages.** Popular songs, albums, singles and EPs, compilations and appearances, each on its own tab.
- **Search for albums and artists.** Results now have Songs, Albums and Artists tabs, and any album opens without saving it first. Song search returns up to 50 results instead of 20.
- **Sort the songs in a playlist.** Every playlist and Liked Songs has a sort button: playlist order, recently added, oldest added, title, artist or album. Each list remembers its choice, and playback follows the order on screen.
- **Custom song order.** Drag songs into your own order, or right-click one to move it to the top or bottom.
- **Clickable names.** Click an artist or album on a song row, or the artist or song title in the player bar, to open its page.
- **Back.** A back button returns through the pages you've opened. Alt+Left and the mouse's back button work too.
- **Shuffle and repeat buttons** beside the player controls. Repeat cycles through off, all songs and this song.

## Changed

- **Much less memory when the window is large.** About 60 MB down to 32 MB maximized on a 1080p screen, and 30 MB down to 25 MB in the default window.
- **Almost no memory in use while in the tray.** Spoty stops drawing while it's hidden or minimized and hands back the memory only drawing needed.
- **Lighter covers and song details.** Thumbnails are decoded at the size they're drawn and capped at about 400 KB, and song and album details kept in memory are now limited.
- **Faster start.** Spoty no longer downloads your whole Liked Songs list at startup just to find out who is signed in.

## Fixed

- **Next and Previous.** Next could do nothing and Previous could only restart the song, after Spotify's autoplay moved on or when resuming the song Spoty opened with. They now always move between songs, and Spotify takes over when your list runs out.
- **Previous goes back.** It now always goes to the previous song instead of restarting the current one after the first 3 seconds. On the first song of a list it restarts.
- **Repeat.** With repeat on "this song", a song that ends no longer moves on to the next one. A mode chosen before the player was ready now still applies.
- **Swapped songs.** A song Spotify swapped for another release of itself no longer stops the queue from moving on.
- **Scroll position.** Each list now keeps its own instead of sharing one.

## Good to know

- Custom orders are saved on your PC, not on Spotify, so they won't show up in other apps. Songs added to the playlist later appear at the end.
- Sorting by title, artist or album needs one request per song, so those sorts are for lists of up to 1,000 songs.
- Spoty isn't made or endorsed by Spotify.
